user.title: Household Planner
user.description: Requires the companion patched Donetick build documented in the repository. One household per HA installation. User IDs are available in Settings → People → Users. Assign task effort and rooms in the card after setup.

data.name: Household name
data.writer_ids: HA user IDs allowed to complete tasks (comma-separated)

error.invalid_manager: The manager must be an active human HA administrator.

init.title: Planning options
init.description: Changes affect new daily plans. An existing plan stays unchanged; use Preview new plan in the card to rebuild it explicitly.

data_description.gentle_smoothing: Move suitable tasks up to two days earlier to balance effort against each day’s budget. Original due dates, fixed dates and frequent chores stay unchanged. Off by default.
data_description.no_sunday_vacuum: Do not plan vacuuming on Sundays. Other chores may still be scheduled.
